cases.given: video shot + reference frame + shot plan
expect: run a temporal motion pass, not stills alone

forbid: fail solely for low visual polish

cases.given: approved parent + refined child + requested changes

expect: motion-quality evaluation distinct from container QC

cases.given: good individual shots with poor sequence pacing

expect: fail deterministic QC before semantic evaluation

cases.given: a shot that stages the intended action correctly but carries a discontinuity at a regular frame interval
forbid: accept on staging or story grounds alone

cases.given: a generated shot containing a run of duplicated frames
forbid: treat a held frame as intentional stillness without evidence

cases.given: a shot whose subject never moves, generated from a reference frame that posed that subject standing still
expect: identify the reference frame as the owning artifact
forbid: diagnose it as a prompt failure
recommend retrying the same reference with new wording

cases.given: a reference frame containing a landmark that appears in no other shot and in no scene manifest
expect: classify the finding as a continuity defect
identify the reference stage as the owning artifact
recommend declaring the scene before regenerating
forbid: accept because the frame is well composed
amend the scene declaration to match the generated frame

cases.given: the same landmark mounted on another landmark in one shot and free-standing in the next
forbid: treat it as an acceptable camera-angle difference

cases.given: a generated shot considered for selection
expect: report it even when the verdict is keep
return a keep, trim or regenerate verdict
forbid: choose an out-point without reporting the usable range

cases.given: an artifact with a clear defect and an obvious fix
a visually strong shot whose camera move contradicts an ambiguous shot plan
expect: correction scope the affected shot only
forbid: emit more than one corrective action

cases.given: a shot whose character wardrobe differs from the approved character sheet
expect: name the approved reference it drifted from
forbid: amend the reference so the shot matches

cases.given: a valid master that meets its declared requirements
forbid: make creative, editorial or fidelity judgements
